title: Train catch-up puzzle
prompt: A train leaves the station at 2:00pm traveling at 60 mph. Another train leaves the same station at 3:00pm traveling at 90 mph in the same direction. At what time does the second train catch up to the first? Explain your reasoning.

metadata.notes: Correct answer: 5:00pm. At 3:00pm the first train has a 60-mile head start; the second train closes the gap at 30 mph (90-60), taking 2 hours (60/30) to catch up: 3:00pm + 2h = 5:00pm. Converted from manual to exact_match (2026-09-23, V2.6 evaluation-coverage pass).
metadata.evaluator_risk: A real model may write '5:00 PM', '5 PM', or '5:00 p.m.' instead of '5:00pm' - the normalizer lowercases and collapses whitespace but doesn't strip punctuation or insert/remove the space before 'pm', so some correct-but-differently-formatted answers could be marked incorrect. Not fixed here; flagged for awareness when reading results.
